turns.text: Hello, my print still hasn't arrived and I need help with the delivery.

Hello, I'm sorry your print has not arrived yet. I can help with that. To find your order, please send me your order number (it looks like SC-1007) and the email address you used when you placed the order.
I'm filing a complaint with the consumer authority ANPC today. I'll also contact my bank for a chargeback and leave a public review.
I'm sorry the delivery has caused you this much trouble. I'm passing your case to a colleague who can look into it with you. They will take over this chat shortly.
